title: Microprofile cost & latency playbook
body:
Purpose:
This is a working playbook for designing the Console view that surfaces per-invocation microprofiles: fine-grained per-token cost and latency breakdowns plus contextual traces. Goal is to iterate quickly on wireframes and a small backlog of deliverables we can ship in 2 sprints. Keep it lightweight, product-focused, and implementation-aware (SRE/serving-runtime constraints).

Audience and personas:
- Platform Engineer (Emma) — cares about tail latency, hotspot tokens, routing policies. Needs quick filters and exportable traces.
- App Engineer (Sam) — focused on per-route cost, costly prompts, where to add caching or shorter context.
- Product Ops / FinOps (Ravi) — wants cost attribution by team/feature and monthly trends.

Non-goals (for this phase):
- Full token visualizer with token coloring by semantic role (future).
- Real-time streaming flamegraphs. We'll show sampled traces for long requests.

Key metrics surfaced in the view (priority order):
1) Per-invocation total tokens (input + output) and token units cost estimate (USD).
2) Per-token latency contribution: model compute vs network vs prefix cache retrieval.
3) Token-level KV cache hit/miss markers.
4) Operator actions recommended: enable prefix cache, lower temperature, switch to quantized model variant.

Wireframe concepts (sketch notes):
Top-level: Invocation list (table) -> click -> Microprofile pane (right rail or modal)
- Invocation row columns: timestamp | route | model | tokens (I/O) | total-cost | latency 95th | tags (sampled)
- Row action: View microprofile (opens stacked timeline)

Microprofile pane sections:
A) Summary header: small badges (route, model, region), total tokens, estimated cost, latency histogram (mini). Quick actions: Snapshot to compare, Flag for review, Export JSON.
B) Token timeline (primary): condensed horizontal swimlane of tokens (index left->right). Each token is a 1px–n pixel block where height indicates compute time and color indicates source of delay (green compute, orange I/O, purple cache miss). Hover tooltip: token text, token index, compute_ms, cache_hit boolean, kernel used, prompt-role (user/system).
C) Waterfall breakdown (below timeline): stacked bars per token showing compute | memory-copy | network | cache-lookup. Y-axis tokens, X-axis ms. Zoom / focus on token range.
D) Cost attribution strip: per-token USD estimate (very small values) and a running cumulative cost line. Toggle to show cost-per-1000 or raw cents for readability.
E) Policy suggestions: inferred actions from heuristics (e.g., prefix-cache will reduce 60% of fetch time for these tokens). Buttons: Apply suggestion (opens rollout wizard), Add to eval set.

Prototype interaction notes:
- Default sampling: show microprofile for 1% of invocations, but allow user to request an on-demand full trace for specific invocation ids.
- Performance: timeline rendering must aggregate tokens when >2k tokens; provide a zoom slider.
- Export: JSON schema should match serving-runtime trace v2 so infra can replay traces locally.

Mock UI copy (short):
- "Microprofile — Invocation 2025-10-31T14:22:09Z"
- Badge: "Tokens: 1,824 | Cost: $0.042 | Latency: 1270ms (p95)"
- Tooltip header: "Token #432 — \"function\""
- Suggestion card header: "Enable prefix cache for /chat route — est. 40% latency reduction"

Acceptance criteria (MVP):
- [ ] Invocation table shows route/model/tokens/cost/latency and opens microprofile modal.
- [ ] Microprofile modal displays timeline + waterfall + token hover details for traces up to 2k tokens.
- [ ] Export JSON button produces trace v2 compatible file.
- [ ] Basic heuristics produce actionable suggestions (at least 3 rules).
- [ ] UX tests with 3 engineers and 2 product ops yield at least 2 actionable changes (e.g., cache config change, model variant switch).

Technical constraints & notes for eng:
- Use sampled RPC traces from runtime: include fields {invocation_id, tokens[], token_timestamps[], kernel_tags[], cache_flags[], regional_hops[]}. If token text cannot be logged for pii customers, still allow latency-only traces (anonymized tokens: token_0, token_1).
- Rendering: prefer Canvas for token timeline (performance). Fallback to SVG for small traces.
- Backend: new endpoint /internal/trace/microprofile?invocation_id= that requires owner permissions. Must respect privacy flags.

Backlog (ordered):
- CON-812: microprofile basic modal + invocation table link (sprint A)
- CON-835: token timeline canvas renderer with zoom/aggregation (sprint A)
- CON-847: export trace v2 and replay harness (sprint B)
- CON-881: prefix-cache suggestion engine integration and rollout hook (sprint B)
- CON-915: permissioning and pii-anonymized traces toggle (sprint C)

Open questions / tradeoffs:
1) How much token text can we expose by default? (Legal & Privacy) -> default to anonymized; opt-in for plaintext with audit log.
2) Cost estimation granularity: USD per microsecond vs per-token bucket. -> prefer per-token cents + aggregated display to avoid small decimals.
3) Sampling rate tradeoff: more samples gives better coverage but cost/ingestion. -> default 1%, configurable per org.

User research snippets (from hallway interviews 2025-10-01):
- "I mostly want to find the single token that spikes compute — then I can try truncation or rephrasing." — Backend eng
- "An export to replay locally would unblock deeper perf debugging in our infra. JSON is fine." — SRE
- "Show me cost per-route and ability to attribute to feature flag." — FinOps

Design notes (visual language):
- Use thin token bars with subtle gradients. Colors must be colorblind-safe (use texture pattern for cache miss if necessary).
- Small font for token indices; main hover panel is focus for text.

Next steps / immediate owners:
- Aisha: synthesize and produce low-fidelity wireframes (Figma page: Console / Microprofiles) by 2025-11-07
- Marco (frontend): spike canvas prototype for token timeline (due 2025-11-14)
- Lina (SRE): define trace v2 export contract and privacy knobs (due 2025-11-10)
- Ian (product-ops): recruit 5 beta users for quick feedback (due 2025-11-21)

Notes to self / rough TODOs to capture later:
- Add cross-link to per-route ECON dashboard and cost-allocator view.
- Consider aggregated heatmap for repeated invocations (hot token positions).
- Add short video GIF example for PRs to showcase animation.

End of playbook (work-in-progress).
